title: Problem Parsing Package on any attempted update
symptom: Every time I go to update xDrip (I'm running version 17cbcf0-2021.03.08) I get a pop up saying "There was a problem parsing the package." Running on Android 12 December update on a Pixel 4 XL.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It is suggested that the error is raised by the Android package manager during installation, possibly due to a connection problem or an issue with the package, but no specific cause is confirmed.
fix: The user was able to install the update by installing it from the files app rather than directly through xDrip. The issue was not reproducible afterwards and was closed.
evidence_quote: I was able to install it over. The difference was that I installed it from the files app rather than directly through xdrip
